1.t: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,

5.t: Then turneth it to russet stubble.

6.t: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget

7.t: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;

8.t: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.

9.t: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.

11.t: But the most hapless will flout it,

12.t: He who will be flung to the great Fire

13.t: Wherein he will neither die nor live.

15.t: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,

16.t: But ye prefer the life of the world

17.t: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

18.t: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.

19.t: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
